Game Overview

At its heart, Capture Flag is a adventure game about fast-paced action meets classic childhood fun in Capture Flag. Dive into strategic battles where speed and caution are your allies. Assemble weapons, race to snag rival flags, and protect your own. Engage in intense solo missions to dominate the field and claim victory!
